title: Harry Kane and the Race for the Ballon d'Or
seoTitle: Harry Kane and the Ballon d'Or Race
subtitle: Record-breaking performances in the Bundesliga, Champions League, and World Cup boost his bid
excerpt: After scoring 73 goals for club and country, Harry Kane is the top Ballon d'Or candidate, with historic stats in the Bundesliga and Champions League.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Harry Kane arrived at Bayern Munich in 2023 and has since racked up numbers that put him at the forefront of the race for the Ballon d'Or. His streak of goals, titles, and records has sparked intense interest from the sports media and fans alike.

Goals and titles in the Bundesliga

In his first season, Kane scored 36 goals, surpassing any other debutant player. The following year, he repeated the 36-goal mark, winning the Top Scorer Trophy (Torjägerkönig) for the third consecutive time. These goals helped Bayern lift the Meisterschale, reversing their third-place finish from the previous season.

German Cup dominance

In addition to the league, the striker scored in every round of the DFB-Pokal, including a hat-trick in the final, contributing to Bayern's domestic double.

Impact in the Champions League

Kane scored 14 times in 13 UEFA Champions League matches, trailing only Kylian Mbappé (15) as Bayern advanced to the semifinals.

Performance in the 2026 World Cup

At the 2026 World Cup in North America, Kane scored six goals and captained England to third place, their best campaign since 1966. His total of 73 goals for club and country represents the best season by a European player, surpassed only by Lionel Messi (82 in 2011/12).

Qualities supporting his candidacy

Beyond his finishing, Kane demonstrates great vision, dropping deep to receive the ball and create opportunities for teammates like Michael Olise, Luis Díaz, and Jude Bellingham. He recorded five assists in the Bundesliga and two in the Champions League, including a decisive pass to Díaz against Paris Saint-Germain in the semifinals.

Recognition and anticipation for the ceremony

Former England player Rio Ferdinand stated that only Lionel Messi has scored more goals than Kane in a single season, reinforcing the idea that the striker deserves the Ballon d'Or. The ceremony is scheduled for October 26 in London, Kane's hometown.

With information from Bundesliga.
